_comment: Basic slag, ground (#236, owner 2026-08-18). This is not an invention: ground steelmaking slag
was sold across Europe as a phosphate fertiliser for the better part of a century, under the name
Thomas slag or basic slag. The phosphorus comes out of the ore with the iron and ends up in the
slag, and grinding is what makes it available to a plant.
So the furnace's waste feeds the garden, which is the whole arc of this mod in one recipe.
It does NOT undercut the Compost Heap. Composting is early and organic; this needs a Cupola, which
needs the demolition yard, which means it arrives long after the heap has done its job. It is the
industrial player's second route, not a cheaper first one. Ratio belongs to the balance pass (#36).
Slag can only have ONE pulverizing recipe - the type is one input to one output - so this is the
grinding use, and the aggregate use is a grid recipe instead.
